text.text_excerpt: Our newly opened neighborhood sports bar restaurant. First time here and we're delighted. Great martinis decently priced. Incredibly good truffle fries! And the soft shell shrimp with horseradish sauce were delicious too. Very friendly staff. Can see it becoming a regular hangout. Here again. Very quiet on a Monday night but so deserve a crowd! However, they still need a better range of beers. Fabulous staff though. I've added a star. They've taken advice and increased their range of beers. Really responsive to requests. Love this place.

This is a very underrated place! I like the hot wings and there are tV's everywhere. The people behind the bar are personable and really take care of you. The prices are reasonable as well. Nice addition to Lakeview.

360 degrees of flat screen TVs, 17 if we counted correctly... I ordered a Skinny Patron Margarita and it was really good but it left a strange aftertaste. Perhaps I should have ordered a regular one. I switched to Patron straight up and was more that happy. The staff were very friendly, prompt & patient. We ate nachos that were surprisingly good and an order of pork egg rolls with wasabi sauce. Also surprisingly good. It was pure joy when LSU beat Alabama and the whole place celebrated collectively! How fun is that! I hope to be back for the Saints game today! If not, I see many sports events being watched here in the future! Way to go Azul!
